newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Howard sees Telstra sale in 1997.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Howard sees Telstra sale in 1997.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Thursday he expected one-third of government-owned telecommunications carrier Telstra Corp to be sold within the next 12 months.
"I expect the sale of Telstra some time in the next 12 months," Howard told Perth radio.
"The government is getting ready for the sale sometime in 1997."
On Wednesday, Finance Minister John Fahey said the government was still finalising details for the timing of the partial privatisation.

Legislation for the sale of one-third of Telstra was passed in the upper house of parliament, the Senate, last week and analysts have said the sale is likely to take place in the final quarter of calendar 1997.
The government plans to raise about A$8.0 billion through the sale.
